g.title: claude
g.text: Claude Opus labels on unlabelled photos

g.title: filt
g.text: first_code in label space, non-empty transcript,

g.title: ex
g.text: Exemplars: same-question example span per code
gold root span first, else Claude root line;
never the row itself; spans >= 6 chars

g.title: render
g.text: render(): Grade / Topic / Question / Answer key /

g.title: blendD
g.text: Dev blend -> Sinkhorn lam=.5 toward fit marginals (30 it.)

g.title: fuse
g.text: then Sinkhorn(lam) toward fit marginals (30 it.)

g.title: copus
g.text: Claude zero-shot on dev (gates c, d only)

g.title: cooc
g.text: codes listed together in test top-10s

g.title: bal
g.text: drop truth's example with prob 1 - keep

g.title: smoke
g.text: go only if parse_rate >= .95 and epoch cost < $4

g.title: item
g.text: train_item(): ids = prompt + '\n' + target up to 'ANSWER:' + ' X' + eos
left-truncate only the working if > 2048 tokens

g.title: fwd
g.text: decoder -> hidden states (B x T x 4096)

g.title: lml
g.text: LM loss: token CE on target tokens

g.title: letl
g.text: Letter loss: logits at last token of 'ANSWER:',

g.title: tot
g.text: loss = mean_rows weight x (1.0 x LM + 1.0 x letter)

g.title: sched
g.text: phase a (Claude, ~1,527 updates): 5% warmup + cosine, peak 1e-4
then phase b (gold, ~600 updates): own warmup + cosine, peak 3e-5

g.title: read
g.text: Forward on prompt + text up to 'ANSWER:'
